checks.findings: The answer is assembled from three separated video moments: the three candidates are drawn around 1148.5-1155.2 s, decreasing is identified as the apparent criterion at 1329.1-1339.7 s, and the average-loss minimum at Q=P is restated at 1452.2-1469.8 s.
